title: Fiscal capacity and the flypaper effect
title_zh: 财政能力与粘蝇纸效应
authors: Rodrigo Saens, Paulo Cox, Carlos Villalobos
abstract: This paper unifies public choice and public finance accounts of the flypaper effect under fiscal capacity as a common moderator, thereby organizing previously separate explanations into a single comparative-static framework. Using panel data on Chilean municipalities (2001–2021), we find that the flypaper response declines monotonically with fiscal capacity, from a transfer elasticity of 0.92 in the lowest-capacity quintile to statistical indistinguishability from zero in the highest; own-revenue elasticities show the opposite pattern. The gradient is robust to controls for municipality size and across alternative specifications. We read it as a regime statistic of a permanent institutional configuration with centrally fixed tax rates and formula-based intergovernmental grants, not as a treatment effect. The framework integrates the marginal cost of public funds from public finance with electoral accountability and soft budget constraints from public choice, each yielding the same prediction of monotonic decline. Uniform allocation rules amplify rather than neutralize the asymmetries they were designed to address, with implications for the design of intergovernmental transfer systems in developing countries. abstract_zh: 本文将公共选择与公共财政对粘蝇纸效应的解释统一于财政能力这一共同调节变量之下，从而将此前相互独立的解释整合至一个比较静态分析框架中。利用智利市政当局的面板数据（2001-2021年），我们发现粘蝇纸效应随财政能力单调递减：在财政能力最低的五分之一组中，转移支付弹性为0.92，而在最高组中，该弹性在统计上与零无显著差异；自有收入弹性则呈现相反模式。这一梯度关系在控制市政规模变量及采用不同模型设定后依然稳健。我们将其解读为一种制度配置的体制性统计特征——该配置包含中央固定税率与基于公式的政府间转移支付——而非处理效应。该框架将公共财政中的公共资金边际成本与公共选择中的选举问责及软预算约束相整合，三者均得出单调递减的相同预测。统一分配规则非但未能抵消其旨在解决的不对称性，反而加剧了这种不对称，这对发展中国家政府间转移支付体系的设计具有启示意义。本文为订阅内容预览，请通过机构登录以获取访问权限。

title: An axiomatic approach to the measurement of inequality of opportunity
title_zh: 机会不平等测度的公理化方法
authors: Kristof Bosmans, Z. Emel Öztürk
abstract: We formulate three sets of axioms to measure inequality of opportunity. First, the basic axioms that any relative measure should satisfy. Second, axioms that capture the ex ante perspective, focusing on inequality between individuals with different circumstances. Third, axioms that capture the ex post perspective, focusing on inequality among individuals with the same responsibility characteristics. Based on these axioms, we characterize the ex ante and ex post classes of inequality of opportunity measures. We also discuss how well existing measures in the literature adhere to the axioms.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了三组公理来度量机会不平等。第一组是任何相对度量方法均应满足的基本公理。第二组公理捕捉事前视角，聚焦于不同环境禀赋个体之间的不平等。第三组公理捕捉事后视角，聚焦于具有相同责任特征个体之间的不平等。基于这些公理，我们刻画了事前与事后两类机会不平等度量方法。同时，本文还探讨了现有文献中的度量方法对这些公理的遵循程度。

title: Drain the Swamp: A Theory of Anti-Elite Populism
title_zh: 排干沼泽：反精英民粹主义理论
authors: Gabriele Gratton, Barton Lee
official: 官方在线 2026-01-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study a model of popular demand for anti-elite populist reforms that drain the swamp: replace experienced public servants with novices that will only acquire experience with time. Voters benefit from experienced public servants because they are more effective at delivering public goods and more competent at detecting emergency threats. However, public servants’ policy preferences do not always align with those of voters. This tradeoff produces two key forces in our model: public servants’ incompetence spurs disagreement between them and voters, and their effectiveness grants them more power to dictate policy. Both of these effects fuel mistrust between voters and public servants, sometimes inducing voters to drain the swamp in cycles of anti-elite populism. We study which factors can sustain a responsive democracy or induce a technocracy. When instead populism arises, we discuss which reforms may reduce the frequency of populist cycles, including recruiting of public servants and isolating them from politics. Our results support the view that a more inclusive and representative bureaucracy protects against anti-elite populism. We provide empirical evidence that lack of trust in public servants is a key force behind support for anti-elite populist parties and argue that our model helps explain the rise of anti-elite populism in large robust democracies.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种反精英民粹主义改革的大众需求模型，该改革旨在“排干沼泽”：用缺乏经验的新人替换经验丰富的公务员，而这些新人将随时间积累经验。选民受益于经验丰富的公务员，因为他们能更有效地提供公共产品，并更胜任识别紧急威胁。然而，公务员的政策偏好并不总是与选民一致。这种权衡在我们的模型中产生了两种关键力量：公务员的无能加剧了他们与选民之间的分歧，而他们的有效性则赋予他们更多主导政策的权力。这两种效应都加剧了选民与公务员之间的不信任，有时会诱使选民以反精英民粹主义的周期循环“排干沼泽”。我们研究了哪些因素能够维持回应型民主或催生技术官僚体制。当民粹主义出现时，我们讨论了哪些改革可能减少民粹主义周期的频率，包括公务员的招募以及使其与政治隔离。我们的结果支持以下观点：更具包容性和代表性的官僚体系能够抵御反精英民粹主义。我们提供了实证证据，表明对公务员缺乏信任是支持反精英民粹主义政党的关键力量，并论证我们的模型有助于解释大型稳健民主国家中反精英民粹主义的兴起。

title: Asset Elasticities and Currency Risk Transfer
title_zh: 资产弹性与货币风险转移
authors: Carol Bertaut, Ester Faia, Sebnem Kalemli-Ozcan, Camilo Marchesini, Simon Paetzold, Martin Schmitz
official: 官方在线 2025-09-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We use administrative security-level data from the U.S. and Euro Area (EA) portfolios to estimate asset demand and supply elasticities by exploiting exogenous variation in bond-specific currency wedges. Employing a Bartik-style shift-share identification approach, we document extensive heterogeneity in investor demand responsiveness to exogenous changes in the price of currency risk, conditional on the issuer characteristics. Demand for AE-bonds is always inelastic, whereas for EM-bonds, elasticity depends on investor type and currency: insurance/pension, nonbanks and banks have finite-elastic demand for EM-bonds that are issued in their own (investor) currency. For EM-issuer-currency bonds, only EA non-bank investors increase the share of these bonds in their portfolio when currency wedges widen, suggesting they accept higher currency risk for higher returns. In response, issuers adjust their supply endogenously: an exogenous increase of 8 basis point in currency wedges leads to a 0.26% decline in local currency bond issuance relative to GDP. We develop a theoretical framework where debt issuance decisions take into account heterogenous demand of investors in terms of their response to changes in the price of currency risk.
abstract_zh: 我们利用美国和欧元区投资组合的行政安全级数据，通过挖掘债券特定货币楔子的外生变动，估计资产需求与供给弹性。采用巴蒂克式转移份额识别方法，我们发现，在给定发行人特征条件下，投资者需求对货币风险价格外生变化的响应存在显著的异质性。对发达经济体债券的需求始终缺乏弹性，而对新兴市场债券而言，弹性取决于投资者类型和货币：保险公司/养老基金、非银行机构和银行对以其自身（投资者）货币发行的新兴市场债券具有有限弹性需求。对于以新兴市场发行人货币计价的债券，当货币楔子扩大时，只有欧元区非银行投资者会增加此类债券在其投资组合中的占比，表明他们为获取更高回报而接受更高的货币风险。作为回应，发行人内生调整其供给：货币楔子每外生增加8个基点，本币债券发行量相对于GDP下降0.26%。我们构建了一个理论框架，其中债务发行决策需考虑投资者对货币风险价格变化响应的异质性需求。
